run.change_description:
refactor: resolve SonarQube findings

- Reduce cognitive complexity in runProviderBackups, displayStartupConfig,
  checkProvider, Run and checkProvidersDefined by extracting focused
  helpers; behaviour and log output unchanged.
- Extract duplicated backup status titles into constants with a shared
  backupStatusTitle helper (notify.go).
- Remove TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup2 (identical duplicate of
  TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup) and simplify
  TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup with assertion helpers.
- Dockerfile: merge consecutive RUN instructions, sort apk packages,
  quote the TAG variable in the download URL.

summary.intent: Resolve 13 SonarQube findings (complexity, duplicated literals, an identical test, Dockerfile lint) with behaviour and log output unchanged.
summary.issue_fit: Met - no originating issue; judged against the supplied PR text and the commit message, and every ledger row is met or backed by the focused run. Merged upstream (2026-07-30); reviewed retrospectively as a local range.
summary.coverage: All four changed files reviewed in full; build, vet and `go test ./internal/` pass at the head; live provider tests skip without credentials and the Dockerfile was not built.
check_details: Reviewer ran `go build ./...`, `go vet ./internal/` and `go test ./internal/ -count=1` offline at 136a4850d: all passed (internal 5.163s); the clone tree was unchanged afterwards.

Unavailable: provider-credential tests skip, so refactored backup paths are covered by trace, not execution; Docker is unavailable, so the Dockerfile was read, not built; the PR's golangci-lint result was not reproduced.

observations.fact: The old `checkProvidersDefined` counted the OAuth provider depending on random map iteration order, and the new code computes `bitbucketAPITokenDefined()` once before the loop, which removes that nondeterminism without changing the zero-count outcome.
